title: Interbank Rate Uncertainty and Bank Lending
title_zh: 银行间利率不确定性与银行贷款
authors: Altavilla, Carlo, Carboni, Giacomo, Lenza, Michele, Uhlig, Harald
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We propose a new measure of interbank rate uncertainty, defined as the crosssectional dispersion in interbank market rates for overnight unsecured loans. We show that higher interbank rate uncertainty increases lending rates for firm loans, with larger impacts during financial stress episodes, like the global financial crisis and the European debt crisis. These effects are mitigated for banks with lower credit risk, stronger capital buffers, and greater access to central bank funding. We interpret these findings through a model of bank networks, where interbank rate uncertainty rises with the proportion of thinly connected networks, driving up lending rates to firms.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的银行间利率不确定性度量指标，定义为隔夜无担保贷款银行间市场利率的横截面离散度。研究表明，银行间利率不确定性上升会提高企业贷款利率，且在金融压力时期（如全球金融危机和欧洲债务危机）影响更为显著。对于信用风险较低、资本缓冲更强以及获得央行融资渠道更广的银行，这些影响有所缓解。我们通过银行网络模型解释这些发现：当连接稀疏的网络比例上升时，银行间利率不确定性随之增加，进而推高企业贷款利率。

title: Random Utility with Unobservable Alternatives
title_zh: 不可观测选项下的随机效用
authors: Kono, Haruki, Saito, Kota, Sandroni, Alec
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The random utility model (RUM), a cornerstone in economics, is typically studied under the assumption that choice frequencies of all alternatives are observable. In practice, however, some alternatives have unobservable choice frequencies and are commonly aggregated into a single category called an outside option. We study RUM in such environments and derive a finite, nonredundant system of inequality constraints on observed choice frequencies that characterizes RU-rationalizability. We show that the conventional practice of aggregating unobserved alternatives can miss key information leading to incorrect conclusions such as that observed choices are rationalizable, even when no RUM is consistent with them.
abstract_zh: 随机效用模型（RUM）作为经济学的重要基石，通常在假设所有备选方案的选择频率均可观测的条件下进行研究。然而在实践中，部分备选方案的选择频率无法观测，通常被合并为单一类别，即外部选项。我们在此类环境下研究RUM，推导出关于可观测选择频率的有限且无冗余的不等式约束系统，该系统刻画了RU可理性化的特征。研究表明，将不可观测备选方案进行合并的传统做法可能遗漏关键信息，导致即使不存在任何RUM与观测数据一致时，仍会得出观测选择具有可理性化的错误结论。

title: The Geography of Financial Frictions
title_zh: 金融摩擦的地理分布
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies the aggregate implications of the geography of financial frictions faced by firms in Europe. Using proprietary data from the European Central Bank's Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises, we document three new facts. First, there is substantial regional heterogeneity in the access to external finance. Second, this heterogeneity is persistent, with only gradual convergence over time. Third, countries with tighter financial frictions are less responsive to monetary shocks. To formalize these empirical findings, we develop and calibrate a tractable New~Keynesian model of a monetary union with 22 countries that are heterogeneous in financial frictions, productivity, and size. High-friction countries are less responsive to monetary shocks because firms face a steeper marginal cost curve and a lower capital elasticity. The heterogeneity in financial frictions also shapes the output-inflation trade-off, as in high-friction countries the same output gain comes at the cost of more inflation. Convergence experiments show that financial market integration in the spirit of a European Savings and Investments Union raises the power of monetary policy, but at a potential cost to financial stability.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了欧洲企业面临的金融摩擦地理分布对宏观经济的影响。利用欧洲央行《企业融资渠道调查》的专有数据，我们揭示了三个新事实：第一，外部融资渠道存在显著的区域异质性；第二，这种异质性具有持续性，仅随时间呈现渐进式收敛；第三，金融摩擦更严重的国家对货币冲击的反应更弱。为将这些实证发现形式化，我们构建并校准了一个包含22个国家、在金融摩擦、生产率和规模方面存在异质性的可处理新凯恩斯货币联盟模型。高摩擦国家因企业面临更陡峭的边际成本曲线和更低的资本弹性，对货币冲击的反应更弱。金融摩擦的异质性还塑造了产出-通胀权衡关系——在高摩擦国家，同等产出增长需以更高通胀为代价。收敛实验表明，以欧洲储蓄与投资联盟为蓝本的金融市场一体化将增强货币政策效力，但可能以金融稳定为潜在代价。

title: Ranked choice voting with different elimination procedures
title_zh: 不同淘汰程序下的排序选择投票
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Ranked choice voting (RCV) is one of the fastest-growing electoral reforms in the United States, yet few scholars have considered the degree to which RCV could be improved with a different elimination procedure. This paper examines RCV with three different elimination procedures: plurality elimination, negative plurality elimination, and Borda elimination. After some analytical observations, we examine how often RCV with each of these procedures violates three criteria separately: the Condorcet winner criterion, independence of eliminated alternatives, and monotonicity using data from RCV elections in the United States as well as simulated data from the Impartial Culture condition with some trailing rankings removed. Our results show that while there are few differences in US election data, Borda elimination consistently outperforms the traditional plurality elimination by a statistically significant amount in our simulations. Nevertheless, the magnitude of those difference are often small.
abstract_zh: 排序选择制（RCV）是美国发展最快的选举改革之一，但鲜有学者探讨采用不同淘汰程序能否改进RCV。本文研究了三种淘汰程序下的RCV：简单多数淘汰、负向多数淘汰和波达淘汰。在理论分析基础上，我们利用美国RCV选举数据以及移除部分末位排名的无偏文化条件模拟数据，检验了每种程序下RCV违反三项标准（孔多塞赢家标准、淘汰选项独立性、单调性）的频率。结果表明，尽管在美国选举数据中差异甚微，但模拟中波达淘汰在统计上显著优于传统简单多数淘汰。不过，这些差异的幅度通常较小。

title: Economic Yang–Mills Mass Gap in Global and Corridor Flow Networks: A Finite-Network Gauge-Econometric Framework for Measuring Systemic Shock Thresholds
title_zh: 化肥价格上涨背景下的作物保险与氮肥减量
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study develops a finite-network gauge-econometric framework for measuring systemic shock thresholds in global and corridor flow networks. The central problem addressed is that conventional macroeconomic indicators describe output, growth, income depth, inflation, or trade exposure, but do not by themselves identify how systemic stress circulates through corridor-sensitive network structures or when a local disturbance becomes systemically transmissible. To address this gap, the study constructs a two-layer empirical architecture. Layer A is a completed ten-node benchmark of global and corridor-sensitive regional nodes connected by twenty-seven weighted undirected edges. Public macroeconomic anchors are transformed into a normalized systemic-stress field and then into a corridor-weighted graph, a stress-weighted adjacency matrix, an anti-symmetric economic gauge potential, triangular curvature, Yang-Mills economic action, a stress Laplacian, an Economic Mass Gap Index, fragility, BridgeStress, resilience, and scenario-based shock diagnostics. Layer B specifies a 100-country by 15-year validation architecture, producing a planned N = 1,500 country-year panel for fixed-effects, two-way fixed-effects, Driscoll-Kraay, clustered, dynamic-panel, panel-IV, factor, and external-validation models once the country-year variables are populated and estimated. The corrected benchmark yields a positive finite-network economic mass gap of lambda_1 = 0.3850, with spectral radius 3.5023 and normalized transition threshold 0.1099. Positive spectral separation is retained under high-weight, medium-filtered, and sparse-filtered graph specifications, while Monte Carlo perturbations keep the mass gap positive across the reported uncertainty interval. The curvature-action layer reports total Yang-Mills economic action of 2,514.0 and a top-five action concentration of 78.329%, indicating that systemic stress-energy is concentrated in a limited set of network cycles. Scenario simulations show that inflation, financial-spread, trade/logistics, and energy/geopolitical corridor shocks weaken spectral protection, compress the local-to-systemic threshold, and increase curvature/action concentration. EMGI, fragility, and BridgeStress further distinguish large output-mass nodes from strategically exposed corridor nodes such as the Caucasus and Central Asia. The finite-network dataset and replication package are archived on Zenodo as Version v1, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20786199 (Gondauri, 2026). The study contributes a reproducible macro-corridor measurement pipeline that integrates systemic-risk theory, network topology, spectral graph diagnostics, gauge-theoretic analogy, and econometric claim discipline. The term mass gap is used strictly in the finite weighted-graph sense and does not claim a solution to the mathematical Yang-Mills existence and mass gap problem. Stronger causal and country-level econometric claims are reserved for the populated and estimated N = 1,500 panel.
abstract_zh: COVID-19疫情对国际贸易造成了重大冲击，并引发了对国际供应链负面影响的担忧。通过将一项独特的企业调查与德国行政数据相匹配，我们提供了关于企业如何应对疫情引发的供应链中断而进行调整的新证据。研究发现，因疫情而面临中间投入品获取困难的企业，其调整供应商网络的可能性显著高于未遭遇此类问题的企业，尤其是当供应链中断影响到海外进口时。遭遇供应链困难的企业更倾向于用距离更近的供应商替代距离较远的供应商。然而，这些针对疫情的调整似乎是暂时性的。

title: AI and Coder Employment: Compiling the Evidence
title_zh: 人工智能与程序员就业：证据汇编
authors: Leland D. Crane, Paul E. Soto
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We evaluate whether LLMs have had any discernible impact on the aggregate labor market so far. We focus on occupations that are computer programming-intensive, motivated by data showing that coding is one of the most LLM-exposed tasks. Linking O*NET to CPS we find that aggregate employment of coders has decelerated sharply since the introduction of ChatGPT. Using a novel control variable for industry-level shocks we show that the deceleration is not attributable to the exposure of coders to slowing industries, suggesting instead that coders experienced an occupation-specific shock around the introduction of ChatGPT. Coder employment has continued to grow in recent years, though much more slowly than it did pre-2022. We validate the industry-level control variable by examining historical examples of occupations that experienced either occupation-specific or industry-level shocks. We also provide statistics on the agreement rates between different measures of AI exposure.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）是否对当前总体劳动力市场产生了可识别的影响。基于编码是最受LLM影响的任务之一的数据驱动，我们重点关注计算机编程密集型职业。通过将O*NET与当前人口调查（CPS）数据关联，我们发现自ChatGPT推出以来，编程人员的总体就业增速显著放缓。利用行业层面冲击的新型控制变量，我们证明这种放缓并非源于编程人员所在行业的衰退冲击，而是表明编程人员在ChatGPT推出前后经历了职业特异性冲击。近年来编程人员就业虽持续增长，但增速远低于2022年前的水平。我们通过考察历史上经历职业特异性冲击或行业层面冲击的职业案例，验证了行业层面控制变量的有效性，并提供了不同人工智能暴露度测量指标间的一致率统计。

title: The Extent of the Market for Early American Banknotes
title_zh: 早期美国纸币的市场范围
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using data on interbank relationships and note holdings in Pennsylvania, I estimate the probability that a bank will redeem the notes of other banks by the distance separating them. If two banks were separated by 50 miles, there was a 40 percent probability that a bank would hold the notes of another at a given time. At 200 miles, the estimated probability is virtually zero. My analysis of notes discounted by a small-town, Connecticut banknote broker reveals that distant notes were offered by travelers and traders who moved along the era’s principal waterways.
abstract_zh: 基于宾夕法尼亚州银行间关系与票据持有数据，本文估算了银行赎回其他银行票据的概率与地理距离的关联。若两家银行相距50英里，特定时点一家银行持有另一家银行票据的概率为40%；当距离增至200英里时，该概率几乎为零。通过对康涅狄格州小镇票据经纪人折价票据的分析发现，远距离票据主要由沿当时主要水路流动的旅行者与商人提供。
